arguments.script: UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.ImportAsset("Assets/Resources/KingdomWater.shader",UnityEditor.ImportAssetOptions.ForceUpdate); var s=UnityEngine.Resources.Load<UnityEngine.Shader>("KingdomWater"); foreach(var e in UnityEditor.ShaderUtil.GetShaderMessages(s)) UnityEngine.Debug.Log(e.severity+": "+e.message); UnityEngine.Debug.Log("Water shader supported="+s.isSupported);
arguments.summary: Import revised water shader and inspect compiler messages
